You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact has a subject, a relation, a value, sometimes a condition, and the place it comes from.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the facts, step by step: a repeal or a
  limit "from 20 January" does not yet apply on 16 January.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several facts answer it, list every one of them, in the words of the facts.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- Return JSON only:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: When must guards for moving transmission parts be interlocking movable guards instead of fixed guards?

Facts:
[0] guards for moving transmission parts — requiresMeasure — Interlocking movable guards shall be used (interlocking movable guards shall be used) [condition: where frequent access is envisaged] [REG, Annex III, 1.3.8.1]
[1] guards for moving transmission parts with frequent access — requiresMeasure — Interlocking movable guards (interlocking movable guards) [condition: where frequent access is envisaged] [DIR, Annex I, 1.3.8.1]
[2] guards for moving transmission parts — requiresMeasure — interlocking movable guards (interlocking movable guards) [condition: either fixed guards or interlocking movable guards] [REG, Annex III, 1.3.8.1]
[3] guards for moving transmission parts — requiresMeasure — fixed guards (fixed guards) [condition: either fixed guards or interlocking movable guards] [REG, Annex III, 1.3.8.1]
[4] guards designed to protect persons against moving transmission parts — requiresMeasure — interlocking movable guards (interlocking movable guards) [DIR, Annex I, 1.3.8.1]
[5] guards designed to protect persons against moving transmission parts — requiresMeasure — fixed guards (fixed guards) [DIR, Annex I, 1.3.8.1]
[6] guards for moving transmission parts — addressesRisk — hazards generated by moving transmission parts (hazards generated by moving transmission parts) [REG, Annex III, 1.3.8.1]
[7] moving parts directly involved in the process — requiresMeasure — fixed guards or interlocking movable guards (fixed guards or interlocking movable guards) [condition: when certain moving parts directly involved in the process cannot be made completely inaccessible during operation owing to operations requiring operator intervention] [REG, Annex III, 1.3.8.2]
[8] certain moving parts directly involved in the process — requiresMeasure — fixed guards or interlocking movable guards preventing access (fixed guards or interlocking movable guards preventing access) [condition: when certain moving parts directly involved in the process cannot be made completely inaccessible during operation owing to operations requiring operator intervention] [DIR, Annex I, 1.3.8.2]
[9] moving parts involved in the process — requiresMeasure — interlocking movable guards as referred to in section 1.4.2.2 (interlocking movable guards as referred to in section 1.4.2.2) [DIR, Annex I, 1.3.8.2]
[10] moving parts involved in the process — requiresMeasure — interlocking movable guards (interlocking movable guards) [REG, Annex III, 1.3.8.2]
[11] Power-operated interlocking movable guards — listedIn — 16. (annex i, part b, point 16) [condition: designed to be used as safeguards in machinery referred to in points 9, 10 and 11 of this Part] [REG, Annex I, Part B, point 16]
[12] power-operated interlocking movable guards — listedIn — Power-operated interlocking movable guards (annex v, point 3) [condition: designed to be used as safeguards in machinery referred to in items 9, 10 and 11 of Annex IV] [DIR, Annex V]
[13] certain moving parts directly involved in the process — requiresMeasure — adjustable guards as referred to in section 1.4.2.3 (adjustable guards as referred to in section 1.4.2.3) [condition: when certain moving parts directly involved in the process cannot be made completely inaccessible during operation owing to operations requiring operator intervention] [DIR, Annex I, 1.3.8.2]
[14] sections of the moving parts where access is necessary — requiresMeasure — adjustable guards as referred to in section 1.4.2.3 (adjustable guards) [condition: when certain moving parts directly involved in the process cannot be made completely inaccessible during operation owing to operations requiring operator intervention; restricting access to those sections of the moving parts where access is necessary] [REG, Annex III, 1.3.8.2]
[15] movable guards — requiresMeasure — guard locking device (guard locking device) [condition: Where it is possible for an operator to reach the danger zone before the risk due to the hazardous machinery functions has ceased] [DIR, Annex I, 1.4.2.2]
[16] interlocking movable guards — requiresMeasure — an interlocking device (an interlocking device) [REG, Annex III, 1.4.2.2]
[17] interlocking movable guards — requiresMeasure — interlocking device (interlocking device) [DIR, Annex I, 1.4.2.2]
[18] 1.3.7 moving parts — requiresMeasure — guards or protective devices (guards or protective devices) [condition: where risks persist] [REG, Annex III, 1.3.7]
[19] guard on universal joint transmission — requiresMeasure — The guard must cover the transmission to the ends of the inner jaws (the guard must cover the transmission to the ends of the inner jaws) [condition: in the case of simple universal joints] [DIR, Annex I, 3.4.7]
[20] removable mechanical transmission devices including their guards — listedIn — 1. (annex I, part A, point 1) [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 1]
[21] moving parts involved in the process — requiresMeasure — fixed guards (fixed guards) [REG, Annex III, 1.3.8.2]
[22] guards designed to protect persons — addressesRisk — hazards generated by moving transmission parts (hazards generated by moving transmission parts) [DIR, Annex I, 1.3.8.1]
[23] moving parts involved in the process — requiresMeasure — fixed guards as referred to in section 1.4.2.1 (fixed guards as referred to in section 1.4.2.1) [DIR, Annex I, 1.3.8.2]
[24] movable guards — requiresMeasure — a guard locking device (a guard locking device) [condition: Where it is possible for an operator to reach the danger zone before the risk due to the hazardous machinery or related product functions has ceased] [REG, Annex III, 1.4.2.2]
[25] sections of the parts not used in the work — requiresMeasure — fixed guards or interlocking movable guards preventing access (fixed guards or interlocking movable guards preventing access) [condition: when certain moving parts directly involved in the process cannot be made completely inaccessible during operation owing to operations requiring operator intervention] [REG, Annex III, 1.3.8.2]
[26] Annex I, Part A, point 2 essential requirement — requiresMeasure — Guards for removable mechanical transmission devices (guards for removable mechanical transmission devices) [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 2]
[27] interlocking movable guards — requiresMeasure — stop command (stop command) [condition: whenever those guards are no longer closed] [REG, Annex III, 1.4.2.2]
[28] outside parts of the guard — requiresMeasure — cannot turn with the removable mechanical transmission device (cannot turn with the removable mechanical transmission device) [REG, Annex III, 3.4.7]
[29] interlocking movable guards — addressesRisk — risk of injury (risk of injury) [REG, Annex III, 1.4.2.2]
[30] 1.3.8 choice of protection against moving parts — requiresMeasure — Guards or protective devices (guards or protective devices) [REG, Annex III, 1.3.8]
[31] moving parts — requiresMeasure — fitted with guards or protective devices (fitted with guards or protective devices) [condition: where risks persist] [DIR, Annex I, 1.3.7]
[32] fixed guards — requiresMeasure — fixed by systems that can be opened or removed only with tools (fixed by systems that can be opened or removed only with tools) [REG, Annex III, 1.4.2.1]
[33] essential requirement 1.4.2.3 — requiresMeasure — Adjustable guards restricting access (adjustable guards restricting access) [condition: to those areas of the moving parts strictly necessary for the work] [DIR, Annex I, 1.4.2.3]
[34] guard of the power take-off — requiresMeasure — possible to open this guard (possible to open this guard) [condition: for access to the removable transmission device] [REG, Annex III, 3.4.7]
[35] adjustable guards restricting access — requiresMeasure — adjustable manually or automatically (adjustable manually or automatically) [condition: depending on the type of work involved] [REG, Annex III, 1.4.2.3]
[36] removable mechanical transmission device — requiresMeasure — protected over its whole length (protected over its whole length) [condition: any part that moves during operation] [REG, Annex III, 3.4.7]
[37] manufacturer of the machinery or related product — hasObligation — the appropriate guard(s) shall be provided (the appropriate guard(s) shall be provided) [condition: Where necessary] [REG, Annex III, 2.2.2.1]
[38] guards at landings — requiresMeasure — interlocking device controlled by the position of the carrier (interlocking device controlled by the position of the carrier) [condition: hazardous movements of the carrier until the guards are closed and locked] [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.2.8.5]
[39] guard coverage, simple universal joints — requiresMeasure — cover the transmission to the ends of the inner jaws (cover the transmission to the ends of the inner jaws) [condition: in the case of simple universal joints] [REG, Annex III, 3.4.7]
[40] manufacturer of the machinery — hasObligation — the appropriate guard(s) must be provided by the manufacturer (provide the appropriate guard(s)) [condition: where necessary] [DIR, Annex I, 2.2.2.1]
[41] movement of machinery depending on safe positioning of parts — requiresMeasure — movement of the machinery shall depend on safe positioning (movement of the machinery shall depend on safe positioning) [condition: where it does not give rise to other risks] [REG, Annex III, 3.3.2]
[42] guards at landings — requiresMeasure — interlocking device with guard locking controlled by the position of the carrier (interlocking device with guard locking) [REG, Annex III, 4.1.2.8.5]
[43] protective devices — requiresMeasure — persons cannot reach moving parts (persons cannot reach moving parts) [condition: while the parts are moving] [REG, Annex III, 1.4.3]
[44] guard clearance for drive shaft — requiresMeasure — enough room to prevent the drive shaft damaging the guard (enough room to prevent the drive shaft damaging the guard) [condition: once it is in place] [REG, Annex III, 3.4.7]
[45] moving parts or their housings — requiresMeasure — The same information shall be given on moving parts or their housings (the same information shall be given on moving parts or their housings) [condition: where the direction of movement needs to be known in order to avoid a risk] [REG, Annex III, 1.5.4]
[46] guards and protective devices, general requirements 1.4.1 — requiresMeasure — not be easy to by-pass or render non-operational (not be easy to by-pass or render non-operational) [REG, Annex III, 1.4.1]
[47] 1.3.8 choice of protection against moving parts — addressesRisk — risks arising from moving parts (risks arising from moving parts) [REG, Annex III, 1.3.8]
[48] Machinery or related products presenting risks due to their mobility — definedAs — requires either mobility while working (requires either mobility while working) [condition: the operation requires mobility while working, or continuous or semi continuous movement between fixed working locations] [REG, Annex III, 3.1]
[49] guards and protective devices, general requirements 1.4.1 — requiresMeasure — be securely held in place (be securely held in place) [REG, Annex III, 1.4.1]

response.text: {"kind":"text","value":"Where frequent access is envisaged, interlocking movable guards must be used for moving transmission parts.","text":"Under Annex III, 1.3.8.1 of the Regulation (and Annex I, 1.3.8.1 of the Directive), guards for moving transmission parts must be interlocking movable guards where frequent access is envisaged. Otherwise either fixed guards or interlocking movable guards may be used.","used":[0,1,2,3]}
